name: fairbuild-union-fringes
description: Fairbuild Union Fringes: union fringe benefit remittances by local, fund and month against the hours your payroll shows and the contribution rates you supply: funds paid short or not at all, paid over, paid late, hours reported that do not match payroll, and hours for a local with no rates. Drafts fund letters and records one-click approvals to pay a shortfall. Never pays a fund.
